title: Envelope
description: One hand-off appended to a run's append-only mailbox. Envelopes are the only channel between root and the Orchestrator, and between the Orchestrator and a generated execution agent; a run's state is a pure reduction over the ordered sequence of these envelopes and is never mutated directly. See AI_Codex/Architecture/ADR/0014-generated-workflow-deterministic-kernel.md, decision 2. This is the authoritative Envelope contract; scripts/kernel_specs.py validates every constructed Envelope against this file rather than against a hand-duplicated field list.

schema_version.description: Envelope contract version. Never inferred; always checked explicitly.

envelope_id.description: Unique identifier for this envelope within its run's mailbox. Assignment and ordering are a mailbox concern, not this schema's.

run_id.description: Identifies the run this envelope belongs to. Matches RunSpec.run_id.

sender.description: Role identifier of the envelope's origin: 'root', 'orchestrator', or 'agent:<agent_id>'. Legal sender/recipient pairing (root<->orchestrator, orchestrator<->worker only) is enforced by the router introduced in a later task, not by this schema.

recipient.description: Role identifier of the envelope's destination. Same shape as sender.

kind.description: What the envelope carries: a bounded request to an agent, a completed result, a state/status notice, a question that needs a root answer, or that answer.

payload.description: Kind-specific content, e.g. a compiled brief and its hash for 'request', or a produced artifact and its hash for 'result'. The exact per-kind payload shape is owned by the brief compiler and result gate introduced in a later task, not by this schema.

created_at.description: When the envelope was appended to the mailbox.
